title: Optimal No-Regret Learning for Repeated Prophet Inequality
abstract: arXiv:2609.23265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study repeated prophet inequalities under prefix feedback. In each of $T$ rounds, a learner encounters fresh values drawn independently from $n$ boxes with unknown $[0,1]$-supported distributions in a fixed order and must irrevocably accept one, observing only the prefix up to its stopping box. Regret is measured against the optimal stopping policy that knows the distributions. We give an efficient algorithm achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm explores directly through near-optimal policies, combining empirical backward induction with box-specific reach bonuses. A relative-drop aggregation rule then exploits the nesting structure of observed prefixes to preserve exploration, thereby removing the polynomial dependence on the box number $n$. This resolves an open question posed by Liu et al. (2025).

translated_title: 重复先知不等式的最优无遗憾学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题。在 $T$ 轮中的每一轮，学习者按固定顺序遇到从 $n$ 个盒子中独立抽取的新值，这些盒子服从未知的 $[0,1]$ 支撑分布，学习者必须不可撤销地接受其中一个，且只能观察到直到其停止盒子为止的前缀信息。遗憾度相对于知道分布的最优停止策略来度量。我们给出了一种高效算法，实现了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 的期望遗憾，在对数因子范围内匹配了下界。我们的算法通过近优策略直接进行探索，将经验逆向归纳与针对各盒子的可达奖励相结合。随后，一种相对下降聚合规则利用观测前缀的嵌套结构来保持探索性，从而消除了对盒子数量 $n$ 的多项式依赖。这解决了 Liu 等人（2025）提出的一个开放问题。
tldr: 该论文针对前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题，提出结合经验逆向归纳、盒子可达奖励与相对下降聚合规则的高效算法，实现了匹配下界的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 期望遗憾并消除了对盒子数量的多项式依赖，解决了 Liu 等人（2025）提出的开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient algorithm for repeated prophet inequalities under prefix feedback that combines empirical backward induction, box-specific reach bonuses, and a relative-drop aggregation rule, achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret matching the lower bound while eliminating polynomial dependence on the number of boxes, thereby resolving an open question posed by Liu et al. (2025).
